intended_host: Linux gate host with Gradle capability
scope: Investigate why root check fails dependency-lock resolution for analysis-extras jarValidation at the exact head after the focused core test passed. Compare a clean baseline where useful. Determine whether the existing committed lock edits and remaining lock gaps are expected, incomplete generated state, or environment-specific. If a narrow lock-only repair is established, generate and review it using the supported Linux workflow, push it non-force to the fork branch, and publish a separate exact-head successor gate; otherwise document the blocker and proposed repair. This investigative job does not itself establish a green discovery gate. No live collection writes or public upstream writes.
summary: Investigate and repair discovery gate dependency-lock blocker
